user.title: Where do you walk the dog?
user.description: Rain is predicted for a circle around this point. It starts at your Home Assistant home location — move the marker if you usually walk somewhere else.

schedule_mode.title: Walk schedule
schedule_mode.description: How do you want to describe your walk times?

schedule_times.title: Walk times
schedule_times.description: Add the time each walk usually starts. A day with no walks can be left empty, as long as there is at least one walk somewhere in the week.

params.title: Alert settings
params.description: How far around the walk location to look, what counts as rain, and how far the suggested walk time may move.

data.auto_mute_entity: Mute alerts when this is away

data_description.radius_km: The circle around the walk location that is checked for rain. The minimum keeps the circle larger than one forecast cell.
data_description.intensity_threshold: A moment counts as rainy once the forecast reaches this intensity.
data_description.earlier_margin_min: How much earlier than the scheduled time you are willing to set off. This is also when the notification arrives.
data_description.later_margin_min: How much later than the scheduled time you are willing to set off.
data_description.walk_duration_min: How long a walk takes. The whole walk has to stay dry for a time to be suggested.
data_description.notify_service: The companion app device that receives the push notification. Leave empty for no push notification.
data_description.fire_event: Fires the walk_the_dog_alert event so your own automations can react.
data_description.auto_mute_entity: While this person or device tracker is not home, no notification is sent.

long_walk.title: That is a long walk
long_walk.description: You entered {duration} minutes. Rain forecasts for the next hour are much more reliable than for longer periods, so for walks over {limit} minutes the suggestion will more often be a best guess than a promise. Confirm to keep this duration, or leave it unconfirmed to go back and change it.

error.invalid_time: A walk time could not be read. Use the 24-hour form, for example 07:30.
error.no_walk_times: Add at least one walk time.
error.invalid_notify_service: Pick one of the listed devices, or type a notify service name that starts with mobile_app_.
